literal: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], first month, on jiaxu day, Daozong died; by testamentary edict he assumed the imperial dignity before the coffin.
idiomatic: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], on jiaxu day of the first month Daozong died; by testamentary edict Tianzuo assumed the throne before the coffin.

literal: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.
idiomatic: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.

literal: Second month, on renchen new moon, the era name was changed to Qiantong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the second month the era name was changed to Qiantong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: An edict ordered that those framed by Yelü Yixin should have office and rank restored; those whose property had been confiscated should have it returned; those exiled should be brought back.
idiomatic: An edict ordered restoration of office and rank for those framed by Yelü Yixin, return of confiscated property, and recall of the exiled.

literal: On yiwei day envoys were dispatched to announce mourning to Song and to Western Xia and Goryeo.
idiomatic: On yiwei day envoys were sent to announce mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo.

literal: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.
idiomatic: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.

literal: Third month, on dingmao day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to distribute Zhang Xiaojie's family members among the hundred officials.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the third month an edict ordered the relevant offices to distribute Zhang Xiaojie's family members among the hundred officials.

literal: On jiaxu day the monk Fayi was summoned to grant precepts in the inner court.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the monk Fayi was summoned to grant precepts in the inner court.

literal: Summer, fourth month, drought.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, there was drought.

literal: Sixth month, on gengyin new moon, went to Qing Prefecture.
idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the sixth month the court went to Qing Prefecture.

literal: On jiawu day Song dispatched Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Song sent Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.

literal: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to offer condolences.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to offer condolences.

literal: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.

literal: On gengzi day Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.

literal: On renyin day Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.
idiomatic: On renyin day Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.

literal: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.
idiomatic: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.

literal: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.

literal: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guihai day Zubu and Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the seventh autumn month Zubu and Iron Li came with tribute.

literal: Eighth month, on jiayin day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiayin day of the eighth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Ninth month, on renshen day paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On renshen day of the ninth month the court paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.

literal: On yihai day halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On yihai day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the tenth winter month the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

literal: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.
idiomatic: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.

literal: Initially Yangge was made military commissioner of the Raw Jurchen Division; their custom called him Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: Initially Yangge was made military commissioner of the Raw Jurchen Division; their custom called him Grand Preceptor.

literal: That year Yangge died and the post passed to his elder brother's son Wugusun; when Wugusun died, his younger brother Aguda succeeded.
idiomatic: That year Yangge died and the post passed to his elder brother's son Wugusun; when Wugusun died, his younger brother Aguda succeeded.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the second year, in the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

literal: Second month, on xinmao day went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Third month, great cold; ice formed again.
idiomatic: In the third month there was great cold and the ice formed again.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day, an edict ordered execution of Yixin's faction and relocation of their sons and grandsons to the border;
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the fourth summer month an edict ordered execution of Yixin's faction and relocation of their sons and grandsons to the border;

literal: Yixin's and Delite's tombs were opened, coffins split, and corpses dismembered;
idiomatic: Yixin's and Delite's tombs were opened, coffins split, and corpses dismembered;

literal: their families were distributed to the households of those who had been killed.
idiomatic: their families were distributed to the households of those who had been killed.

literal: Fifth month, on yichou day Wotela presented the victory of the Yeduoge and other divisions.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the fifth month Wotela presented the victory of the Yeduoge and other divisions.

literal: Sixth month, on renchen day, because of rain the hunt was abandoned and the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the sixth month, because of rain the hunt was abandoned and the court halted at Sanshui Plain.

literal: On bingwu day Xia King Li Qianshun again dispatched envoys requesting marriage to a princess.
idiomatic: On bingwu day Xia King Li Qianshun again sent envoys requesting marriage to a princess.

literal: On dingwei day Southern Court great king Chenjianu retired.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Southern Court great king Chenjianu retired.

literal: On renzi day Li Qianshun, attacked by Song, dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
idiomatic: On renzi day Li Qianshun, attacked by Song, dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.

literal: Intercalary month, on gengshen day, examination of worthy talent.
idiomatic: On gengshen day of the intercalary month worthy talent was examined.

literal: On renshen day Favored Consort was demoted to commoner.
idiomatic: On renshen day Favored Consort was demoted to commoner.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted at Black Ridge; because of heavy rain, horses were given to the hunters.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Black Ridge; because of heavy rain horses were given to the hunters.

literal: Zubu came to invade; Wotela and others defeated them.
idiomatic: When Zubu came to invade, Wotela and others defeated them.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on yimao day Xiao Haili rebelled and plundered the armory of Qian Prefecture.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the tenth winter month Xiao Haili rebelled and plundered the armory of Qian Prefecture.

literal: Northern Court linya Hao Jianu was ordered to capture him; Xiao Haili fled into the Adian division of the Peishu River.
idiomatic: Northern Court linya Hao Jianu was ordered to capture him; Xiao Haili fled into the Adian division of the Peishu River.

literal: On bingyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wotela was made Northern Court privy commissioner; third associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wotela was made Northern Court privy commissioner; third associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs.

literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day Hao Jianu, for failing to capture Xiao Haili, was dismissed from office.
idiomatic: On yiwei day of the eleventh month Hao Jianu, for failing to capture Xiao Haili, was dismissed from office.

literal: On renyin day Supreme Capital intendant Yelü Shensi was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On renyin day Supreme Capital intendant Yelü Shensi was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

literal: The relevant offices requested that the emperor's birthday be made the Tianxing Festival.
idiomatic: The relevant offices requested that the emperor's birthday be made the Tianxing Festival.

literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on xinsi new moon, went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the third year, on the xinsi new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

literal: Jurchen sent Xiao Haili's head in a box and dispatched envoys to present it.
idiomatic: Jurchen sent Xiao Haili's head in a box and dispatched envoys to present it.

literal: On wushen day went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: On wushen day the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Second month, on gengwu day, because of great flood at Wuqing County, prohibitions on ponds and marshes were relaxed.
idiomatic: On gengwu day of the second month, because of great flood at Wuqing County, prohibitions on ponds and marshes were relaxed.

literal: Summer, fifth month, on wuzi day, because many hunters had fled, strict statutes were established.
idiomatic: On wuzi day of the fifth summer month, because many hunters had fled, strict statutes were established.

literal: On yisi day took summer ease at Chile Ridge.
idiomatic: On yisi day the court took summer ease at Chile Ridge.

literal: On bingwu day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Sixth month, on xinyou day Xia King Li Qianshun again dispatched envoys requesting marriage to a princess.
idiomatic: On xinyou day of the sixth month Xia King Li Qianshun again sent envoys requesting marriage to a princess.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, at Central Capital hail damaged the crops.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month hail at Central Capital damaged the crops.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiachen day went to Central Capital.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the tenth winter month the court went to Central Capital.

literal: On jiwei day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On jiwei day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On gengshen day Xia State again dispatched envoys seeking aid.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Xia State again sent envoys seeking aid.

literal: On jisi day rites were performed at Guande Hall.
idiomatic: On jisi day rites were performed at Guande Hall.

literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; general amnesty; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eleventh month civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; a general amnesty was proclaimed; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.

literal: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.
idiomatic: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.

literal: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.
idiomatic: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.

literal: On yisi day paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
idiomatic: On yisi day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.

literal: Great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.
idiomatic: The great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.

literal: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.
idiomatic: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.

literal: Twelfth month, on wushen day went to Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the twelfth month the court went to Ousi Marsh.

literal: That year advanced scholars Ma Gonghui and one hundred three others were released.
idiomatic: That year advanced scholars Ma Gonghui and one hundred three others were released.

literal: Second month, on dingchou day the Nose-bone tribe dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingchou day of the second month the Nose-bone tribe sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Summer, sixth month, on jiachen day halted at Wangguo Cliff.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the sixth summer month the court halted at Wangguo Cliff.

literal: On jiayin day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Xia State sent Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.

literal: On guihai day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On guihai day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, locusts at Nanjing.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month there were locusts at Nanjing.

literal: On gengchen day hunted at Southern Mountain.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the court hunted at Southern Mountain.

literal: On guiwei day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi and associate Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Shensi both administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi and associate Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Shensi both administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.

literal: On xinmao day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Dili was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
idiomatic: On xinmao day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Dili was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiyou day a phoenix appeared at Yin.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month a phoenix appeared at Yin.

literal: On jiwei day went to Nanjing.
idiomatic: On jiwei day the court went to Nanjing.

literal: Eleventh month, on yihai day at Welcome Moon Tower money was bestowed on poor people.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the eleventh month at Welcome Moon Tower money was bestowed on poor people.

literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou day Zhang Lin was made Southern Court chancellor.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the twelfth month Zhang Lin was made Southern Court chancellor.

literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yihai day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and others to seek aid and also requested an attack on Song.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on yihai day of the first spring month Xia State sent Li Zaofu and others to seek aid and also requested an attack on Song.

literal: On gengyin day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Changge was made Northern Court chancellor.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Changge was made Northern Court chancellor.

literal: On dingyou day privy council academician Gao Duanli and others were dispatched to admonish Song to cease attacking Xia troops.
idiomatic: On dingyou day privy council academician Gao Duanli and others were sent to admonish Song to cease attacking Xia troops.

literal: Second month, on guimao day made a private tour to observe the people's hardships.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the second month the emperor made a private tour to observe the people's hardships.

literal: On bingwu day went to Mandarin Duck Marsh.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court went to Mandarin Duck Marsh.

idiomatic: On renshen day of the third month a clanswoman Nanxian was enfeoffed Princess Cheng'an and married to Xia King Li Qianshun.

idiomatic: On jiashen day of the fourth summer month the court shot tigers at Charcoal Mountain.

idiomatic: On renzi day Song sent Zeng Xiaoguang and Wang Jian on a return mission.

idiomatic: On yimao day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

idiomatic: On wuxu day of the eleventh winter month merchants' households were forbidden to take the advanced-scholar examination.

idiomatic: On bingchen day Goryeo Duke of Three Han States Wang died; his son sent envoys to announce it.
